text_block_list.text:
—Nice Nature was acting strange ever since 
that morning.

When I headed toward the school gates for 
my usual commute to work...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Wait a sec. Isn't this bad?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ambushing people at the school gates first 
thing in the morning... now that I think 
about it, isn't that a bit intense?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
My quick plan totally backfired... If it's 
come to this, then—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hyaaah!?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ah, wa, waaah! It's Trainer-saaan.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"What a coincidence running into you here~ 
No really, there's coincidences, and then 
there's this."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Um, we've got training this afternoon, 
right? Let's both give it our all until 
then!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Oooh! ...Just kidding~...

Like when you suddenly came to the 
trainer's office around noon...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Um, you see.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Um... There's something I wanted to give 
you, Trainer."
choice_data_list: Something you want to give me?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...I see. That is... truly... quite 
something.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: —It's "fried chicken," though!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
No, the old guy at the butcher shop just 
gave me a bunch of free extras~.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
These make the perfect snack to go with a 
drink, don't they? Please, don't be shy 
and have some!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Alright, I'll give it to you later...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...It's fine, there's still time. Smooth 
and quick, just get it done...
Even during a training break...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer-san—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—Nah, a track jacket is a total no-go. 
Never mind, forget it.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Guess I'll go fetch some water...
—And then.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, this is fine right here. Thanks for 
your hard work today too~

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ahhhhh!! Wait!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Um, hey, you see...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: —You're forgetting the fried chicken!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
The stuff to share with everyone! I'll go 
grab it right now, so hold on...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...You coward!

After that, Nice Nature gave me some fried 
chicken, which also came with handmade 
chocolates labeled "Extra Bonus Gift."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: —Did you forget anything?!”

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
No, wait, that's... Well, not totally 
wrong, but still!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Not that...! Argh, jeez~~!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: This is...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...Valentine's chocolates. Though 'a 
small token of appreciation' might be more 
accurate, yes."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I mean, it's totally normal, right? To 
show some appreciation to your Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I've had tons of people drill into me just 
how important good manners are, you know?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
So, even though it's not much, I felt like 
I just had to give this to you...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"N-No, I just thought... maybe I'd give it 
to you... so I tried making it..."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I say "made," but... all I really 
did was chop and mix things!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...You might not even be happy getting 
something from me, but..."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...H-Hey, come on. Why are you staying 
silent...?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I'm the only one looking like an idiot 
here... Say something, come on...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Really?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Not just out of courtesy?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ugh...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Then that's good, yes.

The chocolate I received from Nice Nature 
tasted somehow incredibly sweet.
